Semantic summary: sets hardware alpha-blend register 0x04000052 (BLDALPHA=0x1010, not the template's BG2 affine-scale register), allocates two rectangle-blit heap routines via direct Func_080ed408(46,7,7,11,2)/Func_080ed408(47,7,7,3,3) calls and reads their function pointers back from heap_cache[7]/heap_cache[8] (matching the template's idiom, with this owner's own distinct id/flash-count constants), opens three effect registrations via Func_080e0524 (against extra_target=heap_cache[2], work, and work+0x2F8), seeds a 32-slot ring at work+0x7080 with a random low byte and a constant high field, resets a 512-slot shared particle pool's lifetime sentinel to -1, then runs 96 animation passes. Each pass conditionally draws one sine/cosine-orbiting rectangle for its first 80 passes (fixed x amplitude, frame-shrinking y amplitude -- unlike 080e01e4's shared-amplitude marker), walks 10 fixed ring slots with a staggered per-slot activation threshold (frame >= 16 + slot*4), drawing and decaying each active slot every pass it stays active and, exactly once per slot (the pass its threshold is first crossed), spawning a 16-particle burst into that slot's private sub-range of the shared 512-particle pool and, if the target has any real party members, cueing Func_080d6888/Func_080b5088 for each one. Finally every pass scans all 512 shared particle slots, drawing and aging every slot whose lifetime sentinel is not -1, using the same half=(idx+(u32)idx>>31)>>1 / Data_080ede48[idx-1] table-lookup idiom already established in 080e01e4.c.

Per CONTRIBUTING.md's ban on hand-forced register assignment/scheduling, the remaining differing_halfwords were investigated only through genuine source-level restructuring (declaration order, statement order, loop-counter variable identity/scope, re-read-vs-cache idiom choice) with each candidate independently measured via tools/compiler candidate-show --align, never through asm()/register hints/PERM_GENERAL forcing. The residual left open (extra_target/rectangle_a/rectangle_b landing at stack offsets 32/28/24 in the candidate vs the reference's 20/24/28, with a knock-on 4-byte candidate/reference size difference) is the same class of 'genuinely open, evidence-exhausted-at-the-source-level compiler register/stack-allocation-priority question' already documented after multiple dedicated passes on the closely related sibling 080e01e4 (see that owner's score.note 'open question (b)'); every remaining aligned-diff line in this owner's output is the identical value in a different register or stack slot, never a different computed value, so this is not believed to be a logic error.
No GS2 or external source was used; no other Golden Sun decompilation project was consulted.
